skill.name: culture-index
skill.description: Index and search organization culture documents so teams can find values, practices, and guidelines.
skill.summary: Search team culture documentation for values, practices, and policy guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is a prompt-only documentation helper with no executable code, no tool instructions, and no required network activity. The two static network findings are hardcoded GitHub source references in SKILL.md, so they are false positives for runtime network risk.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is front matter pointing to the public source repository. It does not instruct the model to make a network request or transmit data.
The URL appears in a Resources section as a source repository link. It is documentation context, not executable behavior or data exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Culture documentation becomes hard to use when values, practices, and guidelines are spread across many files. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code index and search those materials.
actual_capabilities: Identifies culture documents that should be indexed.
Organizes culture-related documentation for later retrieval.
Searches indexed materials for values, practices, and guidelines.
Retrieves relevant culture guidance for team questions.
Supports building a searchable culture knowledge base.
limitations: Does not include executable indexing code or a bundled search engine.
Depends on the user providing culture documents or repository context.
Cannot verify whether policies are current unless source documents are current.
Does not replace HR, legal, or compliance review.

use_cases.title: Create a Culture Knowledge Base
use_cases.description: Organize values, practices, and team guidelines so employees can search them during daily work.

use_cases.title: Support Team Onboarding
use_cases.description: Find culture guidance that explains how a team works, communicates, and makes decisions.

use_cases.title: Maintain Culture Documentation
use_cases.description: Review related culture pages and identify areas that need clearer indexing or retrieval paths.

prompt_templates.title: Find Culture Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the culture-index skill to search these culture documents for guidance about team communication. Summarize the most relevant points.

prompt_templates.title: Index Culture Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Organize a small set of documents
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the culture-index skill to review these culture documents. Create an index of values, practices, guidelines, and related topics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Related Practices
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the culture-index skill to search for onboarding, remote work, and decision-making practices. Compare the guidance and note any conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Culture Knowledge Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the culture-index skill to map culture documentation into categories, source references, owner suggestions, and gaps that need follow-up.

output_examples.input: Search our culture docs for remote work expectations.
output_examples.output: Remote work guidance found: teams should document availability, meeting norms, and response expectations. The strongest matches are remote work guidelines and communication practices.

output_examples.input: Index these values and onboarding pages.
output_examples.output: Suggested index: values, team rituals, onboarding expectations, communication norms, decision practices, and escalation guidance. Several onboarding topics reference team rituals.

output_examples.input: Find gaps in our culture knowledge base.
output_examples.output: Potential gaps: decision-making ownership is unclear, remote work guidance lacks examples, and onboarding references are split across several pages.

best_practices: Provide the document scope before asking for indexing or search.
Ask for source references when using results for policy decisions.
Refresh the index after major culture or policy updates.
anti_patterns: Do not treat outdated documents as current guidance.
Do not use search results as final HR, legal, or compliance advice.
Do not ask the skill to infer policy when the documents provide no evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill help me find?
faq.answer: It helps find values, practices, guidelines, and related culture information from provided documentation.

faq.question: Does it include a search engine?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides prompt guidance for indexing and searching culture documents through the AI assistant.

faq.question: Can it update our policies?
faq.answer: No. It can identify and summarize guidance, but policy changes should be reviewed by the responsible owners.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the relevant culture documents, folders, or repository context and describe the topic you want to search.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive HR documents?
faq.answer: Use normal data handling controls. Provide only documents that the assistant is allowed to read and summarize.
